invariants: No agent role has ACT authority.
Only the Engineer role is builder-eligible for candidate software modification.
A builder may never verify its own work.
Verifier independence group must differ from the builder independence group.
Work cannot become COMPLETE directly from RUNNING; it must enter VERIFYING and receive PASS.
Stale lease generations cannot heartbeat or submit.
Expired work is requeued without erasing prior run/event history.
Evidence is persisted as sanitized references/hashes, not private payload bytes.
Model-tier ceilings are role ceilings only; the Step 13 router/provider registry still controls whether a model route exists.
